instructions: Classify the claim against only the supplied evidence. Do not use world knowledge. Different time or viewpoint does not establish a contradiction. Inference is not a directly supported source fact.

criteria.supported: Evidence directly establishes the entire claim.
criteria.contradicted: Evidence explicitly contradicts the claim in the same time and viewpoint.
criteria.unsupported: Evidence is clear but does not establish this claim.
criteria.insufficient_context: Ambiguous references or missing context prevent interpretation.
